name: Helpdesk Network
summary: Perth PC support + dialup/ADSL ISP (HelpNet, ~2004); defunct (GRAHAM CHARLES BOASE (sole trader), ABN 60 794 973 083).

events.details: Defunct. With only two archived captures (Dec 2004 live ISP, Apr 2017 parked), the unsupported 2007 estimates give way to the last hard evidence of retail-ISP life in Dec 2004. last retail ISP homepage Dec 2004; parked by 2017.

refs.label: 12 Dec 2004: the ONLY live capture of this micro Perth ISP-reseller; content last updated 29 Nov 2004.
By Apr 2017 (the only other capture ever taken) the domain was a Netregistry parked 'BizCard' page; no 2005-2016 captures exist.
